args.content:
## Landscape Summary
- 11 systems: corp.itsm, emarsys.cx, my.mes, sap.ariba, sap.crm, sap.ehs, sap.odm, sap.s4, sap.sf, siemens.plm, workday.hcm

## SAFETY & COMPLIANCE REPORTING ⭐⭐⭐
- **sap.ehs:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1** - Autonomously analyzes SafetyIncidents; generates structured root cause analysis reports with regulatory impact; supports audit trails and evidence-based documentation

## INBOUND MATERIAL RECEIPT & INSPECTION ⭐⭐⭐
- **my.mes:agent:SupplierQualityComplianceOrchestrator:v1** - Processes incoming material inspections; monitors supplier quality metrics and vendor compliance; orchestrates quality certifications against POs and contracts; escalates non-conformance issues to vendors; maintains manufacturing standards

## BOM COMPLIANCE VALIDATION ⭐⭐⭐
- **siemens.plm:agent:BOMComplianceValidator:v1** - Validates BOMs against regulatory/supplier qualification requirements; flags non-compliant materials; recommends approved substitutes; generates compliance documentation; capabilities: validate-bom-compliance, assess-material-compliance, verify-component-standards, check-engineering-standards

## PRODUCT TRANSITION & ENGINEERING CHANGE COMPLIANCE ⭐⭐⭐
- **siemens.plm:agent:EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning:v1** - Coordinates engineering changes; orchestrates material provisioning; synchronizes configuration updates; includes coordinate-bom-updates capability
- **my.mes:agent:ProductionChangeOrchestrator:v1** - Alternative: Automates engineering change propagation; performs impact assessments on materials and product items; coordinates synchronized updates
- **sap.ariba:agent:MaterialAndEngineeringChangeCoordinator:v1** - ⭐ SUPPLY CHAIN READINESS - Monitors engineering changes & material modifications; coordinates updates across product items & purchase orders; validates material specs against compliance; ensures procurement network propagation; handles material mgmt & supply-chain automation for new/modified BOM items

## PRODUCTION SCHEDULING & MACHINE ALLOCATION ⭐ NOT FOUND
- Searched my.mes (MES) and sap.s4 (ERP) for production scheduling/sequencing/machine allocation optimization
- Found: ProductionQualityMonitor (quality focus), EquipmentOEEAnalytics (OEE only)
- Missing: No agent for production order sequencing, machine allocation optimization, or production scheduling with delivery date optimization

## WORKFORCE SCHEDULING ⭐ NOT FOUND
- Activity: Plan Workforce Scheduling for Production Shift
- Searched workday.hcm (HCM system): Found agents for Compensation, Performance Reviews, and Safety
- Missing: No agent for shift planning, employee schedule management, or time-off request orchestration
